definitions.explanation: Someone who has a lot of money.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}はお{金持|かねも}ちだ。
お{金持|かねも}ちになりたい。
{彼女|かのじょ}はお{金持|かねも}ちの{家|いえ}に{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: She was born into a wealthy family.

examples.japanese: お{金持|かねも}ちだからといって、{必|かなら}ずしも{幸|しあわ}せとは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: Being rich doesn't necessarily mean you're happy.

examples.japanese: あの{町|まち}にはお{金持|かねも}ちが{多|おお}くて、{大|おお}きな{家|いえ}がたくさん{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: There are many wealthy people in that town, and large houses line the streets.

notes:
お{金持|かねも}ち literally means 'money-haver.' The お prefix adds politeness.

FORMS:
- {金持|かねも}ち: plain form (can sound blunt)
- お{金持|かねも}ち: softer, more common form

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{金持|かねも}ちになる: to become rich
- お{金持|かねも}ちの{家|いえ}: a wealthy family/household
- {大|おお}{金持|がねも}ち: very rich person

SYNONYMS AND RELATED:
- {裕福|ゆうふく}な: wealthy (adjective, formal)
- {富豪|ふごう}: wealthy person, magnate (formal)
- {成金|なりきん}: nouveau riche (often negative)

OPPOSITE:
- {貧乏|びんぼう}: poor
- {貧乏人|びんぼうにん}: poor person
